Your future role:

As Head of Sales qPCR, you will be responsible for the further development of national sales (DE) and international launch (AT, CH, Europe) and market development of our qPCR product line "Lab direct qPCR." As the person responsible for acquisitions, you will initiate and coordinate market activities, act as the primary contact for our customers, ensure that their demands will be satisfied, and provide excellent customer service. Your goal is to sustainably establish FRIZ as a reliable partner for qPCR diagnostic solutions and increase customer satisfaction, loyalty, and company growth by developing customized sales solutions, negotiating contracts, and implementing strategies to ensure customer satisfaction.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Customer acquisition and establishment of long-term partnerships for our Lab direct qPCR products in AT, CH and Europe including laboratories, distributors, (research) institutes, hospitals, and industry partners
- Development and documentation of country-specific pricing strategies in terms of reimbursement and regulation within a framework of the company´s strategy and internal guidelines
- Development and implementation of international marketing and sales strategies in cooperation with general management
- Offer, draft and contract management as well as cost accounting according to general management requirements
- Collection and analysis of data on procurement, pricing, order volumes, distributors and total sales
- Ensuring compliance with relevant standards and guidelines for IVDR products in the different countries

Your ideal qualifications:

- At least 3 years of professional sales experience in the field of molecular diagnostics
- Expertise as a sales representative for regions outside Germany
(Europe/Austria/Switzerland)
- Established and engaged network with active relationships among key stakeholders in the European laboratory community
- Own experience in the lab with qPCR and molecular biology techniques is an advantage
- Excellent written and spoken German and English. French is an advantage
- Confident use of MS Office and modern communication tools

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
